definitions.gloss: trouble; effort (mostly in 造作もない)
definitions.explanation: The trouble or effort something takes. Used almost only in the negative {造作|ぞうさ}もない or {造作|ぞうさ}なく, "with no trouble at all", to say that something is very easy.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{造作|ぞうさ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{造作|ぞうさ}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{持|も}ち{上|あ}げた→持ち上げる：02313_mochiageru⟧。
examples.english: He lifted the heavy box with no effort at all.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧、⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧くらい⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{造作|ぞうさ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ことだ。
examples.english: For her, writing an email in English is nothing.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
The same kanji read ぞうさく is a different word: the fixtures and fittings of a house, or (informally) the shape of someone's face (⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{造作|ぞうさく}). Also written {雑作|ぞうさ}.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {造作|ぞうさ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: no trouble at all, very easy
- {造作|ぞうさ}⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: easily, effortlessly
- {造作|ぞうさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かける: to put someone to trouble (old-fashioned)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{朝飯前|あさめしまえ}→朝飯前：10551_asameshimae⟧: a piece of cake — more casual
- ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧: easy, simple — the everyday word
